notes.title: Preparing for release + Demo update!
notes.content:
[p][b]HEY![/b][/p][p]i've uploaded a new DEATH IN ABYSS demo update! 
the last update was back in october 2024, so a lot has happened since then! 
demo now features new enemies, powerups, 1+ stage, visual changes and more. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="UyYBGodWBLQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984030/Death_In_Abyss_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]release info[/b] 
i'm currently working on polishing the full game, which can now be fully played from start to finish! 
the save system in the demo, which allows you to have up to 5 profiles, should be compatible with the full game when it comes out. 
there's also cloud-save support now!

i'm really excited to show u what i've been working on, and releasing v1.0 somewhere in november looks very doable.[/p][p]i'll soon invite active members on our discord to playtest the full game somewhere between august / september, so if you want to participate, come join![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/DEseUGr"]https://discord.gg/DEseUGr[/url][/p][p][/p][p]cheers,
André[/p][h2][/h2]

notes.title: Demo Update - September 2024
notes.content:
Hey, made some changes to the demo!

v.10009
-Made lazer attacks more readable.
-Some visual changes to the Player UI. Should be more intuitive to understand how your health works.
-Removed Player i-frames. Feels odd to dodge through attacks. 
Example with Nightdrifter tentacle attack; you could just dodge right through it without taking damage. 
This change is on trial, let me know if it is a good change or not.
-Adjusted spawn amount + respawn time on Tumor Islands.
-Adjusted world colors.
-Adjusted sounds and music for some creatures.

Cheers everyone for playing and for providing your awesome feedback, I read them all.
-André

notes.title: 3 weeks since demo launch, thank you for playing!
notes.content:
Hey!
In case you missed it, the demo went live 3 weeks ago. Here's the trailer:

[previewyoutube=cTo2RkIpqqs;full][/previewyoutube]

Post-release, the demo has been played by 1500 people, and registered on 5000 accounts!
Thank you everyone for playing and providing your awesome feedback. You help make the game as cool as it can be.
It's soon been 2 years since I started this project, so getting to this point is sick.

But man, I must say, I wish I waited like 2 weeks with launching it! 
Steam recently launched a big update which give devs way more tools for their demo page. 
Quite bad timing. :P
 
--

[b]Made some changes to the demo:[/b]
-Reduced total of eyes on Nightdrifter from 6, to 4. 
First phase takes a bit too long, and is not that fun when you gotta do it over again if you die later in the fight.
-Nerfed damage on the Lazer enemy from 50% to 33%. Should give player more time to learn it's mechanics.
-Made it more clear you gotta destroy the remaining Tumor Islands after reaching 100% progress.

-Disabled controller support for now. 
It's a bit unstable / not optimized. Players risk stumbling into game breaking bugs atm.
For now I'll just focus on mouse & keyboard to make development more smooth, and add controller back in at a later point in production.


Thanks again for playing everyone, this has been an awesome milestone to reach! 
Can never be enough testers though, so spread the word about the game, help reach out to more!

And if you haven't played yet, then wow...
Go play, or else...

... Yh...


Until next time,
André

notes.title: Death In Abyss is a creepy submarine action game in which your ship does the backstroke
notes.content:
I have played many a creepy throwback game that takes inspiration from the ever inadequately named "Golden" (Grimy and Diseased? Cadaverous, perhaps) Age of survival horror on PS1, but it's rare you play one that invokes the N64, and even less often that you stumble on something horror-adjacent that riffs on Star Fox 64. Ah, Star Fox! The natural companion piece for, say, Eternal Darkness or The Suffering. In fairness, I did always find those Pez dispenser dialogue animations pretty eerie.
